title: Replace serde_yml (RUSTSEC-2025-0068 unsound/unmaintained; transitive noyalib RUSTSEC-2026-0333)
description: serde_yml 0.0.13 is flagged unsound + unmaintained with no fixed version; it pulls noyalib 0.0.5 (resource budgets not enforced on typed deserialization). Used in src/frontmatter.rs, src/audit/{fixes,invariants}.rs, src/workspace.rs, src/ops/{structural,content}.rs, src/commands/{reconcile,sources_cmd}.rs.
